name: Standard Notes
author: Standard Notes
summary: An end-to-end encrypted notes app for digitalists and professionals.
description:
Standard Notes is an end-to-end encrypted note-taking app for digitalists and professionals.
Capture your notes, files, and life’s work all in one secure place.
